annotation.bound_parties_text: The Administrator (of the FAA) is directed to develop a plan, charter a rulemaking committee, deploy and test detection and mitigation systems, and brief Congress; the plan may not delegate authority to other Federal, State, local, territorial, or tribal agencies.
